appDescription.message: Analyze webpage HTML with your own AI model, preview answers, select options, fill fields, and continue to the next question.

actionTitle.message: Answer Agent: Open panel (right-click for more interfaces)

taskHint.message: Auto answer selects or fills answers and proceeds to the next question or page. Some sites grade answers immediately. Preview first.

modelPlaceholder.message: Enter the model ID provided by your service

effortHint.message: Select an effort level only if your model supports it.

requestSummary.message: Request a reasoning summary (supported Responses models only)

keyHint.message: Optional; saved locally and restored after restarting

keyPlaceholder.message: Leave blank for local services without authentication

deleteKeyHint.message: Clear the API Key field and save to delete the remembered key.

vision.message: This model supports images (send accessible question and option images)

privacyHint.message: Starting analysis sends this page's HTML and element information to your model to identify questions and plan actions. Enable images to include accessible images.

logHint.message: Shows progress, waiting time, answer explanations, and reasoning summaries returned by the service, not the model's full internal reasoning.

usageNotice.message: For practice or authorized use. Model answers may be incorrect.

emptyLogs.message: No logs yet. Start analysis to view progress.

emptyOverlayLogs.message: Start a task to view run logs.

overlayLogs.message: Run logs (right-click the dot to expand)

overlayHint.message: Select and fill answers, then continue to the next question.

taskEnded.message: The task ended. Reopen the extension and try again.

clearLogFailed.message: Unable to clear logs. Reload the extension.

copyDenied.message: Clipboard access was denied. Select and copy the logs manually.

restrictedTab.message: The active tab is not a supported webpage.

pageChanged.message: The tab or page changed. Analyze the target page again.

endpointChanged.message: The API domain changed. Clear the old key or enter a key for the new service.

settingsSaved.message: Model settings saved. You can analyze the current page.

answerSkipped.message: The model did not provide an actionable suggestion. Skipped.

htmlTruncated.message: The HTML limit was reached; only part of the page was sent

noAnswer.message: The model did not provide an actionable answer.

configureFirst.message: Enter and save your model settings first.

readingHtml.message: Reading page HTML and available elements…

timeoutNoClick.message: The model request timed out after 120 seconds. No clicks were made.

useSidebar.message: Use the side panel to start answering.

dotShown.message: The dot is in the bottom-right corner. Click to start; right-click to expand.

floatingShown.message: The floating window is in the bottom-right corner. Start answering from the webpage.

stopNext.message: Stopped. No further questions will be started.

stopping.message: Stopping. An action already in progress may have changed the current answer.

siteAccess.message: In the extension's browser settings, set site access to 'On all sites'.

activeTabChanged.message: The active tab changed. Operations stopped.

protectedPage.message: This page is protected or is not a regular webpage. Use an HTTP or HTTPS page.

pageReadFailed.message: Unable to read this page. Wait for it to finish loading, then try again.

unknownTarget.message: The model returned an element that was not provided.

verifyFailed.message: Unable to verify this action. The page may have changed or reloaded.

clickUnverified.message: Clicked; the page does not expose a selection state

alreadyMatches.message: Already matches the desired state; no action needed

localPageChanged.message: The page changed. Analyze it again.

targetChanged.message: The target changed or is not actionable. Analyze the page again.

inputNotRetained.message: The field changed or did not retain the entered value.

nextClicked.message: Clicked next question/page. Waiting for new content.

selectionMismatch.message: The selection does not match the expected state after clicking.

noSelectionState.message: The click was simulated; the page does not expose a verifiable selection state.

timeout.message: The model request timed out after 120 seconds.

noChangeEvidence.message: The model did not provide verifiable new-question text. Page text changes alone do not count as a new question.

repeatedQuestion.message: A previously processed question was detected. Stopped to avoid answering it again.

invalidActions.message: The model returned invalid actions. Automatic navigation stopped. Check the logs and analyze again.

checkingNext.message: Current-page actions are complete. Asking the model whether there is a next question/page…

noNext.message: The model found no next question. Answering finished.

foundNext.message: The model identified a next question/page.

nextNotClickable.message: The next-question control cannot be clicked. Check the run logs.

stillSameQuestion.message: The previous question is still shown or the new question has not loaded. Waiting before checking again; not answering again.

invalidEndpoint.message: Enter a full API endpoint, such as http://localhost:11434/v1.

insecureEndpoint.message: Use HTTPS (HTTP is allowed for loopback services). Do not include credentials, query parameters, or fragments.

invalidSettings.message: Invalid API protocol or reasoning effort.

protocolMismatch.message: The endpoint does not match the protocol. Change the protocol or enter a base URL without an API method suffix.

responsesIncomplete.message: The Responses API did not return a complete answer. No clicks were made.

responsesEmpty.message: No Responses text answer was received. Check the model and endpoint.

replyTruncated.message: The model response was truncated. Reduce the number of questions on the page and retry.

chatEmpty.message: No model text was received. Check Chat Completions compatibility.

invalidJson.message: The model did not return valid JSON. No clicks were made.

missingAnswers.message: The model response has no answers list. No clicks were made.

connectionFailed.message: Unable to connect to the model API. Check the endpoint, service, and browser permissions. Redirects are not supported.

badRequestHint.message: Check the protocol, reasoning effort, and image support. Use Service default if reasoning parameters are unsupported

endpointError.message: Check the endpoint and model name

notApiJson.message: The model service did not return JSON. Enter an API endpoint, not a website URL.

noSummary.message: No reasoning summary was returned. The model's answer explanations are shown below.

noExplanation.message: The model did not provide an explanation.

modelHostFailed.message: Unable to start the background model request.

offscreenReason.message: Run a packaged model-request Worker for the webpage answering interface.

overlayTaskStart.message: Continuous answering started from the webpage interface.

modelNotConfigured.message: No model is configured. Save model settings in the side panel first.

stopActions.message: Stopped. Actions already performed will not be undone.

taskAlreadyRunning.message: This tab already has an answering task.

taskPageChanged.message: The page or tab changed. Answering stopped.

responseLanguageInstruction.message: Return explanations and status messages in English. Preserve the original language of question text, evidence excerpts, and answers required by the question.

suggestionsReady.message: AI identified $arg1$ questions in the HTML and suggested answers.

applySummary.message: Verified $arg1$ questions; $arg2$ require verification; skipped $arg3$. The extension did not click Submit. $arg4$

apiPermissionDenied.message: The browser denied access to the model API. $arg1$

sendingHtml.message: Sending page HTML to $arg1$ to identify questions and plan actions…

pageAccessDenied.message: The browser denied access to this page. $arg1$ Extension stores and browser internal pages remain unsupported.

pageAccessUnknown.message: This page may be protected or site access may be denied. For a regular webpage: $arg1$

imagesUnavailable.message: $arg1$ images could not be read or exceeded the image limit

imagesNotSent.message: $arg1$ images were not sent. Enable image support in model settings

noActionsSummary.message: No actionable answers on this page. Processed $arg1$ pages and $arg2$ questions.

incompleteSummary.message: Some actions on this page are incomplete or unverified. Navigation stopped. Processed $arg1$ pages and $arg2$ questions.

verifyNext.message: Next was clicked. Asking AI to verify the new question ($arg1$/3)…

noNewQuestionSummary.message: Next was clicked, but repeated checks did not confirm a new question. Stopped without re-answering or re-clicking. Processed $arg1$ pages and $arg2$ questions.

pageLimitSummary.message: Reached the 100-page task limit. Processed $arg1$ questions.

modelRequestStats.message: Phase: $arg1$; $arg2$ · $arg3$ · Effort: $arg4$; HTML: $arg5$ characters, $arg6$ elements, $arg7$ images.

modelWait.message: Waited $arg1$ seconds for an answer or reasoning summary…

modelCompleted.message: Finished in $arg1$ seconds; planned $arg2$ questions; ignored $arg3$ invalid responses.
